entities.summary: Tunku Ampuan Najihah binti Almarhum Tunku Besar Burhanuddin was the Tunku Ampuan of Negeri Sembilan. She was formerly the Tunku Ampuan Besar or queen consort of Negeri Sembilan from 1967 to 2008. She also served as Raja Permaisuri Agong of Malaysia between 1994 and 1999.
